# jason v1.4.5 - Table of Contents

A blazing fast JSON parser and generator in pure Elixir.

## Pages

- [Jason](https://jason.hexdocs.pm/readme.md)
- [Changelog](https://jason.hexdocs.pm/changelog.md)
- [LICENSE](https://jason.hexdocs.pm/license.md)

## Modules

- [Jason](https://jason.hexdocs.pm/Jason.md): A blazing fast JSON parser and generator in pure Elixir.

- [Jason.Encode](https://jason.hexdocs.pm/Jason.Encode.md): Utilities for encoding elixir values to JSON.

- [Jason.Encoder](https://jason.hexdocs.pm/Jason.Encoder.md): Protocol controlling how a value is encoded to JSON.
- [Jason.Formatter](https://jason.hexdocs.pm/Jason.Formatter.md): Pretty-printing and minimizing functions for JSON-encoded data.
- [Jason.Fragment](https://jason.hexdocs.pm/Jason.Fragment.md): Provides a way to inject an already-encoded JSON structure into a
to-be-encoded structure in optimized fashion.
- [Jason.Helpers](https://jason.hexdocs.pm/Jason.Helpers.md): Provides macro facilities for partial compile-time encoding of JSON.

- [Jason.OrderedObject](https://jason.hexdocs.pm/Jason.OrderedObject.md)
- [Jason.Sigil](https://jason.hexdocs.pm/Jason.Sigil.md)

- Exceptions
  - [Jason.DecodeError](https://jason.hexdocs.pm/Jason.DecodeError.md)
  - [Jason.EncodeError](https://jason.hexdocs.pm/Jason.EncodeError.md)
